text:
The dish is a small bowl, roughly 15 cm across at the rim, though in the image it spans about 220 px, so it may be closer to 12 cm. It holds cut strawberries, filled to roughly the rim.

For volume, a bowl about 12-13 cm wide and 5 cm deep holds roughly 300 ml. Strawberry halves packed loosely fill about 60% of that, so about 180-200 g of strawberries.

Strawberries run about 32 kcal per 100 g, so 190 g comes to roughly 60 kcal. I'll round up slightly to allow for any sugar.

{"kcal": 65, "mass_g": 200}
